findings.detail: Official Eponet documentation confirms the QR code uniquely identifies the charging point, displays Charger ID + EVSE ID, and opens a browser flow on portal.eponet.ch where current prices are shown before email/payment.
Eight explicit Charger IDs were recovered from existing production station names, covering 23 EVSEs. See switzerland-epo-charger-id-pivot-2026-09-29.json.
station.adhoc/adhoccharging indexes 312 Eponet chargepoints and exact EVSE IDs, but current numeric tariff and payment link are absent on inspected EPO pages.

Eponet took over mobilecharge billing on 2025-10-01 and migrated systems to Eponet. Official migration docs say public Eponet QR stations charge at the QR-code price, but no reusable public legacy mobilecharge tariff endpoint was recovered.
External station pages help confirm exact station/EVSE identity, access and connector data. No authoritative Eponet direct numeric tariff was exposed for tested residuals.
Searches for portal.eponet.ch adhoc/charge/start-price/Charger-ID pages return only the login portal; no indexed public QR route was recovered.
eponet.info/adhoc_laden redirects to a generic Eponet ad-hoc PDF guide, not a station-specific QR target.
Eponet Go package com.eponet.eponet is current and capable of station search/start/payment, but the previously supplied XAPK is not available in the current runtime for static extraction.
TinyFish wallet is negative and Firecrawl has insufficient credits; no paid automation was used.

blocker: Exact station QR target URL/API format on portal.eponet.ch remains unrecovered. Without it, known Charger ID + EVSE pairs cannot yet be converted to current direct prices.
nextFreeActions: Continue mining indexed station pages for additional Charger IDs and exact public/private classifications.
Search legacy mobilecharge public assets and exact EPO station names for migrated payment URL traces.
If the Eponet Go XAPK becomes available again, statically inspect it for portal/API hostnames, route names and request schemas.
If a real Eponet QR code or its decoded URL is obtained from any station, use it as the seed to test all known Charger ID + EVSE pairs.
policy: No tariff extrapolation. External indexes are identity evidence unless an exact current direct tariff is exposed.
